legacy_substrate.what_it_actually_is: Freebase entity nodes of the RoG-webqsp per-question subgraphs of the RoG TEST split ONLY. Verified: src/pipeline/loader_webqsp.py builds master_nodes_webqsp.json from --paths defaulting to data/raw/full/kb/webqsp_test0.parquet + webqsp_test1.parquet (lines 118-123); those two files are sha256-identical to data/original/webqsp/rog_webqsp/test-0000{0,1}-of-00002.parquet (VERIFIED IDENTICAL); recounting the unique triple endpoints of the RoG test parquets gives 781485 entities over 1628 questions (legacy n_docs = 781485); and every legacy question id is WebQTest-* ({'webqsp_q_WebQTest': 1578}). The 'val+train' in sample_rule refers to the substrate's INTERNAL seeded 70/20/10 re-split of those RoG test questions (src/experiments/overlap_retrain._splits fallback), not to official WebQSP train. 'TEST never touched' therefore means the internal 10% cut.
legacy_substrate.classification: SAMPLE_CONDITIONED (corpus = union of the evaluated questions' own subgraphs; also STALE vs the RoG train+val+test entity union)
legacy_substrate.brief_lead_correction: The brief's lead ('RoG train+val subgraph nodes only, built before the RoG test parquet') is NOT what the code shows: the legacy master is built from the RoG TEST parquets; it predates the acquisition of the RoG train/validation parquets (2026-08-23).

WEBQSP_KBQA_24M.what_it_is: PullNet's intermediate filtered Freebase KB, the backend scale reused by the GraftNet/NSM/ReaRev/GNN-RAG line
WEBQSP_KBQA_24M.query_independence_note: MUST NOT be marked query-independent. PullNet defines it as 'a subset of Freebase which contains all facts that are within 2-hops of any entity mentioned in the questions of WebQuestionsSP' (arXiv:1904.09537 s4.1, read from the PDF). That is CORPUS SUBSETTING BY QUERY -- the exact construction canonical_v1's core invariant forbids -- and it fails FREEBASE_SOURCE_PROPOSAL.md s3 test S4. Acquiring it would close a PAPER-COMPARABILITY target, never the corpus-independence requirement, so it may not be used to support the core L1 query-independent-corpus claim.
WEBQSP_KBQA_24M.citation_correction: the 24.9M/164.6M figures are PullNet's (Sun, Bedrax-Weiss, Cohen, EMNLP-IJCNLP 2019, arXiv:1904.09537 s4.1), NOT GraftNet's. GraftNet pages 5-7 were read and do not contain them (it reports 528,617 entity nodes / 513 edge types over retrieved subgraphs).
WEBQSP_KBQA_24M.acquirability: no downloadable artifact exists. PullNet released no repo (GitHub search 'pullnet kbqa' -> 0 results) and described the KB in prose only; GraftNet's nearest relative freebase_prepro.tgz (2.8 GB) sits on a host that no longer answers TCP and was never archived; NSM/ReaRev/GNN-RAG/RoG all ship per-question subgraphs. Any rebuild's relation filter would be OURS (PullNet's was never published) and the result must be named WEBQSP_KBQA_24M_RECONSTRUCTED with measured N/E/R printed beside the paper's.
WEBQSP_KBQA_24M.action_now: DO NOT ACQUIRE. Deferred to a later, separately approved phase.
